slides.title: What the Trial Was Actually Built to Measure
bullets: An endpoint is what a trial measures to determine whether treatment works
The primary versus secondary distinction defines what can be claimed with statistical confidence
Misreading it risks overinterpreting or miscommunicating a study's results

slides.title: The Question the Trial Was Powered For
bullets: The primary endpoint is the outcome the trial is specifically designed and powered to evaluate
It's registered in the protocol, often on ClinicalTrials.gov, before recruitment begins
Meeting the primary endpoint means a statistically significant, and ideally clinically relevant, difference was observed

slides.title: Useful, But Not Confirmatory
bullets: Secondary endpoints are additional outcomes the study also measures, often without dedicated power
They can reveal valuable signals on quality of life, biomarkers, subgroups or longer-term outcomes
Findings on secondary endpoints should be read as hypothesis-generating, not confirmed evidence

slides.title: One Number, Several Events Inside It
bullets: A composite endpoint bundles several events into one outcome, common in cardiovascular and survival studies
Combining events raises event frequency and statistical power
A positive result can be driven by the most frequent or least severe component, not the most important one
Always unpack the components before communicating the headline result

slides.title: Say Which Variable You're Discussing
bullets: Presenting a secondary finding with the same weight as the primary result is a form of communication bias
This outcome switching can undermine trust with an HCP who checks the original protocol
Good practice is to always name the variable, its status, and whether the study was powered for it

takeaway.title: Primary endpoints confirm, secondary endpoints only suggest
bullets: The primary endpoint is the only outcome the trial was powered to prove
Secondary and composite endpoints deserve more cautious, hypothesis-generating language
Naming which endpoint you're discussing protects your credibility with HCPs
